title: Hashing a stream
hints: A hash.Hash is an io.Writer, so you can feed it a whole reader without loading it into memory.
io.Copy(h, r) copies everything from r into h and returns the byte count and the first read error (not counting io.EOF).
n, err := io.Copy(h, r); if err != nil { return "", n, err }; return hex.EncodeToString(h.Sum(nil)), n, nil
